topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe they picked my essay, my words, to show everyone what they're looking for! When I saw it up there, all polished and everything, I just had to take a deep breath. I worked so hard on it, pouring my heart out, and now it's out there, not just for the admissions people but for everyone who's trying to find their way through this crazy application process. It’s a bit overwhelming, to think that my story might help someone else realize they’ve got a shot too. I mean, if this kid from a small town can make it, anyone can, right?
